module: Flowgraph node "Race AI Parameters" (category once_instant, tags ai and race, author BeamNG). Sets once the driving parameters of all AI vehicles (not controlled by a player) listed in raceData.states, via veh:queueLuaCommand to the vehicle's ai module: ai.setAggression, ai.setParameters (edgeDist, turnForceCoef, awarenessForceCoef), ai.setRacing(true), then, if the pins are set, ai.setAvoidCars, ai.setAggressionMode (rubberBand/off) and driveStyle (offRoad/default). Inputs: raceData (must be active with all vehicle states), aggression, racerSkill, randomizationScale, avoidCollisions, rubberband, offroad.
notes: Default values: aggression 0.9 (clamped 0.25 to 2), racerSkill 1 (clamped 0 to 1), randomizationScale 0 (clamped 0 to 2). Random noise is added to each value according to randomizationScale.
Formulas derived from racerSkill: edgeDist = 1.5 - 1.5*skill (m, clamped 0 to 1.5), turnForceCoef = 4*skill^1.5, awarenessForceCoef = 0.25*skill^1.5.
state.baseAggression receives the computed aggression, for later use.

getRandomNumber.desc: Returns a uniform random number in [-scale, scale].

workOnce.desc: Applies the AI parameters to each AI vehicle of the race (only once, on first flow).
